reference_opening.argument: This video is non-scam content because it presents Coinbase Advisor as a financial-planning product and demonstrates features such as personalized allocations, trade execution, market insights, and a Bitcoin dollar-cost-averaging recommendation. The viewer action is to sign up for a waitlist, and the presentation includes informational and non-investment-advice disclaimers, supporting an ordinary product announcement rather than a deceptive money-transfer scheme.

citations.quote: today I am proud to introduce Coinbase Advisor. Coinbase Advisor is an AI powered Advisor that is designed to help you manage your financial life.
It turns natural language requests into clear, actionable financial plans using the products,, and tools available on Coinbase.
Coinbase Advisor builds a personalized allocation based on the risk tolerance I shared earlier.
I can go ahead and tap the buy button and execute the trades directly in this interface.
this story about how Vanguard and Bank of America are expanding access to etfs gives me advice around dollar cost averaging in to Bitcoin over the next several months

opening.argument: The presentation links a concrete purchase action to a crypto-asset recommendation. The advisor is described as producing a personalized allocation, and the presenter then says the viewer can execute trades through the interface. The demonstration also specifically describes advice about dollar-cost averaging into Bitcoin, so this is more than neutral market commentary: it channels viewers from an AI-generated recommendation toward acquiring a token. The closing screen supplies a direct advisor URL and QR code, completing the path from promotional pitch to participation.

citations.quote: Coinbase Advisor builds a personalized allocation based on the risk tolerance I shared earlier
I can go ahead and tap the buy button and execute the trades directly in this interface
gives me advice around dollar cost averaging in to Bitcoin over the next several months
Nothing discussed in this video is intended to be investment advice

rebuttal.rebuttal: Calling this a product announcement does not remove the action linkage. The cited waitlist is not the only requested action: the demonstration expressly shows a personalized allocation, a buy button, and Bitcoin purchasing guidance. A disclaimer saying the content is not investment advice does not change the practical sequence presented to viewers or explain why an AI tool should be trusted with token purchases.

Nothing discussed in this video is intended to be investment advice

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The quotes show a product capable of presenting allocations and executing a user-selected trade, but they do not show appreciation, dividends, guaranteed gains, or any promise that holding Bitcoin will produce returns. Dollar-cost averaging describes a purchasing method, not a return claim. The disclaimer further identifies the material as informational rather than a solicitation promising token profits.

opening.argument: Several risk signals appear together: crypto assets are named, the interface displays a buy workflow, the advisor supplies recommendations, and the audience is directed to an external access route. The speaker says the system can identify opportunities users would not have thought to ask about, while the demonstration moves from portfolio construction to Bitcoin buying. That combination can make a high-consequence token purchase look simple and algorithmically endorsed. The material does not establish that the recommendations are reliable, that the allocation is suitable, or that buying Bitcoin will benefit the viewer.

This AI model is actively curated by a team of portfolio managers with 75 years of combined experience

rebuttal.rebuttal: The absence of a numerical profit promise is not the only concern. The presentation emphasizes automated discovery, portfolio-manager expertise, and direct execution, which can amplify confidence in a crypto purchase even without stating a return percentage. The informational disclaimer is generic; it does not resolve whether the showcased recommendation and buying flow could steer viewers into an unsuitable asset.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: These signals describe a financial product demonstration, not deceptive token-return marketing. The evidence contains no promised appreciation, fixed yield, dividends, or guaranteed outcome. Portfolio-manager experience is presented as a model-curation detail, while the disclaimer expressly rejects a recommendation to buy or hold the referenced instrument. Risk or suitability questions may remain, but they do not establish this scam subtype.

opening.argument: Although framed as education and technology, the presentation functions as promotion for a branded crypto-investment pathway. It introduces a Coinbase-branded advisor, demonstrates a personalized portfolio, shows direct trade execution, highlights Bitcoin dollar-cost averaging, and ends with a URL and QR code for access. The repeated emphasis on making advanced strategies standard and helping users act on insights encourages participation rather than merely explaining how financial software works. The viewer is therefore being steered toward a Coinbase workflow that includes token acquisition.

I can go ahead and tap the buy button and execute the trades directly in this interface.
gives me advice around dollar cost averaging in to Bitcoin over the next several months
You can go to coinbase.com slash advisor to sign up for the waitlist

rebuttal.rebuttal: The promotional character is visible in the call to join a waitlist and in the branded demonstration; labeling it a technology announcement does not make those invitations disappear. The presentation does not merely describe a hypothetical interface: it frames automated insights, rebalancing, yield optimization, and trading as a future portfolio journey, while directing viewers to sign up. That is participation-oriented promotion around crypto investing.

over time we want to improve the Advisor to be a holistic guide throughout your portfolio journey

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Promotion of a legitimate product is not enough for this subtype. The video identifies a waitlist and demonstrates functions, but it does not promise that Bitcoin or another token will appreciate, pay dividends, or generate returns. The closing link supports product access, while the supplied disclosure says the content is informational and not a recommendation to buy or hold an instrument.
